name: Rakugaki Overheart
original_name: らくがきオーバーハート
source:
The main character is back to his hometown for the first time in several years. It seems the town hasn't changed at all. His life is boring just like before...?  No, it's wrong.

He finds a lot of graffiti at school, on the desk, at the corner of the classroom and so on. He soon joins the Graffiti Research Club, which does research or investigate the graffiti found at school. Through various activities, he becomes friends with a lot of students and gradually falls in love with a girl...

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
时隔数年，主人公重返阔别已久的故乡。小镇似乎还是记忆中的模样，莫非接下来的日子也会像从前一样平淡无聊……？不，事实绝非如此。

他在学校各处发现了五花八门的涂鸦——课桌上、教室角落里，几乎随处可见。不久后，他加入了专门调查研究校内涂鸦的“涂鸦研究社”，在丰富多彩的社团活动中结识了许多同学，也渐渐对其中一位少女芳心暗许……

[摘自ErogeShop]
